nodes.label: Location-Free Identity (Kebab-Case Slug)
nodes.rationale: A slug that survives a move keeps links and provenance citations working regardless of where the file lands.

nodes.label: Schema-Derived Placement
nodes.rationale: A schema defines a type's slots, identity key, placement group and write mode, so the same thing written by different writers lands in the same file; system-sourced groups preserve boundaries while menu-sourced groups may be clustered.

nodes.label: Active-or-Invalid File Atom
nodes.rationale: One file holds knowledge that expires as a whole; invalidation comes only from replacement or deletion because partial staleness would poison the file.
